text_en: Thank you!!!_100_ Isn't it amazing how you can't even get a wink of sleep in this monster-riddled cave?
You close your eyes for a second and end up strung up like a leg of ham.
By the way, I'm <color=CHA>Balof</color>,_100_ merchant and friend of the person who saves me, which leads us to you._100_ I don't know how to thank you for taking me off the menu for those spiders.
Wait..._300_ I know! Just a second...
Err..._500_ Was that landslide there a minute ago?_500_ Never mind.
I know it's not exactly a magic ring but, since you've come this far, I think you'll appreciate this.
Why don't you try using one to get us out of here?
A word of advice,_100_ try not to be around when they explode._100_ I wouldn't want to lose my new best friend so soon.

Freeeee!_300_ I'm off...
Oh, by the way!_100_ If you fancy exploring when you get out of here,_100_ to the east of these caves you'll find <color=LOC>Hafin City</color>.
Come and see me!_100_ I'll introduce you to my family and give you something to help you on your incredible adventures._100_ Because you have embarked on an incredible adventure,_100_ right?
